proof_body:
by
  intro ι s x z m V mz Vz hs hVpos hm hV hz hmz hVz
  have hn : (s.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Finset.card_ne_zero.mpr hs)
  have hS : ∑ i ∈ s, x i = s.card * m := by
    rw [hm]
    field_simp
  have hdev : ∑ i ∈ s, (x i - m) = 0 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hS]
    ring
  have hmz0 : mz = 0 := by
    rw [hmz, Finset.sum_congr rfl hz, ← Finset.sum_div, hdev, zero_div, zero_div]
  have hQ : ∑ i ∈ s, (x i - m) ^ 2 = V * s.card := by
    have hVn := hV
    rw [eq_div_iff hn] at hVn
    exact hVn.symm
  have hsq : Real.sqrt V ^ 2 = V := Real.sq_sqrt hVpos.le
  have hc : ∀ i ∈ s, (z i - mz) ^ 2 = (x i - m) ^ 2 / V := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hz i hi, hmz0, sub_zero, div_pow, hsq]
  refine ⟨hmz0, ?_⟩
  rw [hVz, Finset.sum_congr rfl hc, ← Finset.sum_div, hQ]
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ (ι : Type*) (s : Finset ι) (x z : ι → ℝ) (m V mz Vz : ℝ), s.Nonempty → 0 < V → m = (∑ i ∈ s, x i) / s.card → V = (∑ i ∈ s, (x i - m) ^ 2) / s.card → (∀ i ∈ s, z i = (x i - m) / Real.sqrt V) → mz = (∑ i ∈ s, z i) / s.card → Vz = (∑ i ∈ s, (z i - mz) ^ 2) / s.card → mz = 0 ∧ Vz = 1
